_comment: Model descriptions Jev chooses between (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost). Jev never sees names or numbers; these words are the whole basis of its pick. Sources: Artificial Analysis API (intelligence/coding index, speed, first-token time) joined with OpenRouter price/window, plus warslop gates of 2026-10-20/21 (Indonesian answer, tool call, first token, Chinese-leak runs). Cost words: OpenCode Go models are included in a flat subscription; OpenRouter models are pay per use.

ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.good_at: everyday questions, homework help, writing in natural Indonesian, coding and tool use; the fastest to answer

ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.good_at: short and medium general questions, summaries, simple writing and everyday coding; fast, reads images

ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.good_at: careful reasoning and polished, well-structured writing in Indonesian and English, such as CVs, letters and reports

ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging and multi-step tool use (the best coding results among the cheap models), clear Indonesian, reads images; fast

ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.good_at: general chat, summaries and light writing; reads images; the cheapest
ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.weak_at: hard reasoning and code; slower to start

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging and multi-step tool use (the best coding results among the cheap models), clear Indonesian, reads images; the fastest to start answering

openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.good_at: the strongest here at hard reasoning, careful analysis of documents and data, high-stakes advice and long multi-step tool use; quick
openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.cost: pay per use, the most expensive option here

openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.good_at: careful reasoning and polished, well-structured writing in Indonesian and English

ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.good_at: the strongest free option by a wide margin at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use; reads images
ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.good_at: everyday questions and writing in clean Indonesian, simple tool use

openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.good_at: the strongest free option by a wide margin at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use; reads images
openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.good_at: clean Indonesian, short factual answers and simple code
openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.weak_at: hard reasoning and maths (the weakest of the free options); can be slow on long answers

openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.good_at: the strongest cheap all-rounder: hard reasoning and maths, difficult coding, long multi-step tool use and careful answers, reads images; still fast
openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.weak_at: pay per use, so only when the included models are not enough

openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.good_at: quick general questions, chat, summaries and simple coding; very fast and very cheap
openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.weak_at: hard reasoning; does not read images; shorter memory (about a quarter of a million tokens)
